story.iWant: Jarvis to distinguish grounded knowledge from narrative information
story.soThat: decisions, memory, and governance are driven by verified provenance rather than internet noise

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Every stored knowledge unit has immutable `knowledge_tier` field (K0, K1, K2, K3, K4). Tier assignment function: Tier(i) ∈ {K0, K1, K2, K3, K4}. Tiers cannot be downgraded without audit. Governance rules can ban usage of K3/K4 for critical reasoning.

Every knowledge item carries immutable provenance vector: P(i) = ⟨s, o, m, c₀, t₀, K⟩. Ledger is append-only, cryptographically sealed with SHA-256 hashing. Full historical lineage preserved. Queryable by governance & C-IDS.

Each external claim (Tier ≥ K2) must pass two independent cognitive perspectives: Analyst (logical/technical consistency) and Adversary (attack surface, deception potential). Promotion(i) = allowed ⟺ f_A(i) = 1 ∧ f_D(i) = 1. Disagreement freezes the claim at current tier and logs to C-IDS.

Dynamic trust: T(i,t) = c₀(i) · e^(-λ_K · (t - t₀)) where λ_K is tier-dependent decay. K0: λ=0, K1: λ=10⁻⁶, K2: λ=10⁻⁵, K3: λ=10⁻³, K4: λ=10⁻². Decay applies automatically over time. Verified reuse refreshes trust: t₀ ← t. Contradictions accelerate decay: T(i) ← α · T(i) where α ∈ [0.1, 0.5].

Governance defines usage classes: Execution Guidance {K0, K1}, Governance {K0, K1, K2}, Strategy {K0, K1, K2, K3}, Ideation {K0..K4}. Allowed(i, U) ⟺ Tier(i) ∈ U. Enforced at ReasoningEngine. Violations trigger constitutional denial.

All promotions, demotions, conflicts and decay events emit structured events. Event types: promotion, decay, contradiction, freeze, usage_violation. Event schema defined, audit trail queryable, integration with C-IDS for pattern detection.

BMAD may: read all classes, propose hypotheses. BMAD may NOT: promote hypotheses to evidence, upgrade class without human/governance approval, bypass knowledge usage policy, directly modify trust weights.

constraints.constraint: Story 11-5 introduces Lock 7 (Epistemic Sovereignty). Must integrate with existing Locks 1-6 from Stories 11-1b through 11-4. Do NOT break existing capability index, prompt firewall, or cognitive IDS integration.
Provenance ledger is append-only and cryptographically sealed. NO deletions, NO direct updates. Only insertions and tier promotions/demotions via formal state transitions logged in audit trail.
Knowledge tier lattice is IMMUTABLE except by constitutional promotion/demotion. Tier assignment function is pure, deterministic, and cannot be overridden by LLM suggestions.
ReasoningEngine (src/jarvis/agents/reasoning_engine.py) must enforce knowledge usage policy at Lock 7 checkpoint. Integrate after Lock 4 (capability) but before Lock 6 (cognitive IDS).
Trust decay calculation must be lazy (on-demand) not eager. Do NOT recompute trust for all knowledge units on every query. Cache decay results per session.

tests.standards: All epistemic sovereignty components must have ≥90% test coverage. Unit tests for: tier assignment determinism, provenance vector immutability, dual-persona arbitration logic, trust decay calculations, usage policy enforcement. Integration tests for: full promotion workflow (K3→K2 with dual approval), conflict detection and freezing, BMAD read-only access verification.

ideas.idea: Test tier assignment for all source types (telemetry→K0, analytics→K1, papers→K2, news→K3, scrape→K4). Verify tier immutability after creation.
Test provenance vector hashing. Verify append-only ledger rejects deletions/updates. Test lineage reconstruction from ledger.
Test dual-persona arbitration: both approve (promote), analyst rejects (freeze), adversary rejects (freeze), both reject (deny).
Test trust decay: K0 no decay, K4 fast decay. Test refresh on reuse. Test contradiction penalty.
Test usage policy: execution guidance rejects K3/K4, ideation allows all tiers. Test ReasoningEngine enforcement.
Test audit log events for promotion, decay, contradiction, freeze. Verify C-IDS integration.
Test BMAD can read all tiers, cannot promote K3→K2, cannot bypass usage policy.
